h1: Custom Multi Color Headwear for Teams & Events
metaTitle: Custom Multi Color Headwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop bulk custom multi color headwear at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for teams, events, and promotions. Order now!
introHtml: Custom multi color headwear lets you combine two or more brand colors into one hat, cap, or visor for a look that stands out. Whether you need a two-tone snapback for a company picnic or a tri-color beanie for a winter trade show, multi color designs make your logo pop while reinforcing your full brand palette. These pieces work well for teams, departments, or seasonal campaigns where you want to coordinate without matching exactly. Choose from structured or unstructured styles, and add your logo via embroidery or patches.
heroAltText: Custom multi color headwear featuring a two-tone baseball cap with embroidered logo on front
